title: Callisia Repens Bianca - Turtle Vine - 1x Plug Plant - Trailing Houseplant
description:
Callisia repens ‘Bianca’, commonly called Turtle Vine, is a compact, fast-growing houseplant valued for its trailing habit and variegated leaves in green, pink, and white. Its dense, mat-forming growth spills attractively over pot edges and hanging baskets. Small white flowers may appear occasionally indoors.


 Key Features:


  Botanical name: Callisia repens ‘Bianca’
 

  Common name: Turtle Vine
 

  Habit: Trailing, mat-forming
 

  Foliage: Variegated green, pink, and white
 

  Growth: Fast; spreads and trails over pot edges
 

  Flowers: Small, white (infrequent indoors)
 

  Toxicity: Not considered toxic to pets or humans
 

 Care Instructions:


  Light: Bright, indirect light for best color. Can tolerate lower light with reduced variegation. Avoid harsh midday sun.
 

  Water: Keep soil lightly moist; let the top 1 inch dry between waterings. Do not overwater. Avoid misting to reduce fungal risk.
 

  Soil: Use a well-draining potting mix.
 

  Pruning: Pinch or remove solid green leaves to maintain variegation. Trim stems to control size; use cuttings to fill out the plant.
 

  Feeding: During spring and summer, feed sparingly with a balanced liquid fertilizer at half strength.
 

  Temperature: Keep away from drafts or vents to avoid temperature fluctuations.
 

 Propagation:


  Take tip cuttings that include variegated growth. Root easily in soil to create a fuller plant.
 

 Suggested Uses:


  Hanging baskets
 

  Shelf or window ledge accent in bright, indirect light
 

  Mixed indoor displays
 

 What You Will Receive:


  One Callisia repens ‘Bianca’ plant.
 

 Shipping and Handling:


  Secure, protective packing to prevent damage in transit
 

  Ships within the stated handling time; combined shipping available where possible
 

  Weather holds may be used during extreme temperatures
